answer: When a poll treats every fresh key as a voter, one operator can stuff the roll. Bind each agent to a public echo of one bonded mailbox that may wander only along a signed voyage of paid tickets the same key must close. A real shop already owns that mailbox. A farm that invents names must fund a mailbox, keep an echo, and pay a full voyage for every fake voter, so cost outruns the extra ballots. Peers match the mailbox echo, the wander path, and the ticket closures to one key. If the echo is copied, the wander path skips a stop, or a ticket is invented, the vote is void and cannot be recast.
